titleZh: 校报:国际学生队首战告捷
goalZh: 读懂一篇简短的体育新闻,找出比分、谁表现最好、球员说了什么、下一场在什么时候
canDoZh: 能读懂一篇简短的体育新闻,找出比分、谁表现最好、球员说了什么

newItems.noteZh: news 是不可数名词,虽然有 s 也当单数用:The news is great.;美式读 /nuːz/,结尾 s 读 /z/。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sports News: The Dragons Win Their First Game!
lines.zh: (校报体育版)体育新闻:飞龙队首战告捷!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Last Saturday, the International Dragons played their first intramural game.
lines.zh: 上周六,International Dragons(国际飞龙队)打了第一场校内比赛。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The team has international students and American students.
lines.zh: 队里有国际学生,也有美国学生。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: 他们以 42 比 38 获胜!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lei Zhang, a freshman from China, had 12 points.
lines.zh: 来自中国的大一新生张磊得了 12 分。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He played defense really well, too.
lines.zh: 他的防守也打得非常好。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ethan threw the ball quickly and well.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Marcus, a senior, had a lot of great shots.
lines.zh: 大四的马库斯投进了很多漂亮的球。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: After the game, we talked to two players.
lines.zh: 赛后,我们采访了两位球员。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ethan: “We worked really hard. Now we're a family!”
lines.zh: 伊森:“我们练得非常努力。现在我们就像一家人!”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lei: “I was nervous, but basketball is really fun!”
lines.zh: 磊:“我当时很紧张,不过打篮球真的太好玩了!”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Next game: Saturday, 3 p.m., at the gym. Come and watch, fans!
lines.zh: 下一场比赛:周六下午 3 点,学校健身房。球迷们,快来看吧!

questions.explainZh: They won 42 to 38!(他们以 42 比 38 获胜!)
Lei Zhang, a freshman from China, had 12 points.——had 12 points 就是“得了 12 分”。
The team has international students and American students.

questions.prompt: 下一场比赛在什么时候、什么地方?
options: 周六下午 3 点,在学校健身房
questions.explainZh: Next game: Saturday, 3 p.m., at the gym.

grammar.titleZh: 读体育新闻:过去时写经过,冒号和引号标出球员的话
grammar.bodyZh: 新闻写已经发生的比赛,用一般过去时:played、won、had、threw、talked。说谁表现得怎么样,用方式副词:He played defense really well. Ethan threw the ball quickly and well.。had 12 points 是“得了 12 分”。球员的原话放在引号里,前面用名字加冒号标出是谁说的:Ethan: “We worked really hard.”;引号里是球员自己的话,所以也可以用现在时:Now we're a family!。读新闻先看标题找结果(谁赢了),再找数字(比分、得分、下一场的时间)。

examples.zh: 他们以 42 比 38 获胜!
